tasks-for-updating-a-holding-and-termina.text: Tasks for updating a holding and terminating its key on the proved design.
Issue 743. Grouped by pull request and slice of the plan. A task is checked only after the ticket owner accepts its slice.

binding.text: [ ] gate-synthesized: the ticket owner's and the auditor's gate tables synthesized once and frozen with both input hashes.
[ ] removal-decisions-ruled: each removal decision of the plan ruled, and pull request 4's gate rows written.

pull-request-1-singular.text: [ ] termination-preimage-vectors: byte vectors for the termination approval preimage, reproduced on-chain and off-chain.
[ ] termination-fold: the termination change and mixed batches; each statement with a check seen to fail.
[ ] supply-and-history: the four history statements over generated accepted sequences, and the refused registration of a terminal key.

pull-request-1-open-datum.text: [ ] holding-update: the controller-signed update keeping control, tokens and deposit.
[ ] termination-booking: the approval mint, the request shape, the treasury donation equal to the deposit.
[ ] termination-request: spent only with its token and approval burned, by anyone; no stuck termination.

pull-request-2-builders-and-commands.text: [ ] update-and-booking-builders: update and termination booking transactions.
[ ] termination-fold-builder: the shared fold builder over termination requests, from chain data alone.
[ ] commands-and-documentation: the commands with help snapshots, parser rows, recovery partitions and the command reference.

pull-request-3-journey-and-conformance.text: [ ] devnet-journey-continuation: update, booking with the deposit at the treasury, the fold by a second wallet, the refused re-registration.
[ ] devnet-termination-refusals: the four refusals, each with its control.
[ ] conformance-old-versus-new: the update and termination journeys old against new, with the two decided differences.

pull-request-4-the-current-line-removed.text: Pull request 4: the current line removed.
[ ] current-line-removal: the current line's validators, builders, commands, hosted jobs and Lean models removed as ruled.
[ ] established-names: the new commands on the established names.
[ ] documentation-follows: the user documentation describes only the new line.
